blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and October 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 58 in June to 53 in October (−8.6%), and it took 13.7% of the city’s 357 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings rose from 29 in June to 33 in October (+13.8%), and it took 3.2% of the city’s 694 sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out Aldergrove for condos and townhomes in August (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, July, October (a buyers’ best bet).

blocks.text: Condo buildings in Aldergrove

Read this first: Aldergrove's apartment-condo stock is essentially one project. Every verified apartment-condo building below is in Aldergrove Town Centre, on the old Aldergrove Mall site at Fraser Highway and 272 Street.
Shortreed — 27215 Aldergrove Town Centre Dr
One of the three Phase 1 buildings, named for the Shortreed pioneering family; listings record it as built in 2025, with underground parking and two storage lockers for the unit described.
Jackman — 27218 Aldergrove Town Centre Dr
71 homes in 6 storeys, wood-frame construction, freehold strata, strata plan EPS7980, built 2025, managed by Remi (per a building-data source drawing on MLS and public strata records).
Vanetta — 27254 Aldergrove Town Centre Dr

A Phase 1 building named for a pioneering family; listings record it as built in 2026 and describe it, in listing language, as the Town Centre's only steel-frame building, with concrete floors — treat the construction claim as listing-stated until it is confirmed in the disclosure statement or depreciation documentation.
Creekside — 27249 Aldergrove Town Centre Dr

The Phase 2 building, beside Bertrand Creek: 66 homes in 4 storeys, wood-frame construction, freehold strata, strata plan EPS7983, built 2025, managed by Remi Realty, with underground parking, per the same building-data source.
The Hart — Aldergrove Town Centre (civic address not confirmed)
The fifth building in the community, released in 2025 per the marketing firm, offering 1-bedroom, 1+flex, 2-bedroom and 2+flex homes, named for Frederick John Hart.
Streets, schools and getting around Aldergrove

items.t: Aldergrove is a community in the Township of Langley; the Township's eastern boundary is 276 Street at Abbotsford and its southern boundary is the United States border.

Where the condo stock actually concentrates: in one place only — Aldergrove Town Centre, at the Fraser Highway / 272 Street crossroads, on a new internal street, Aldergrove Town Centre Drive. Its buildings (Shortreed, Jackman, Vanetta, Creekside, and The Hart releasing next) all share that one site, beside Bertrand Creek.

Transit from that crossroads: TransLink route 503 (Aldergrove/Langley – Fraser Hwy Express) runs from 272 Street at Fraser Highway via Langley Centre to Surrey Central Station via King George Station, and BC Transit route 21 (Aldergrove Connector) links Aldergrove with Abbotsford from the same stop. There is no SkyTrain or West Coast Express station in Aldergrove.

The Aldergrove Credit Union Community Centre is at 27032 Fraser Highway — pools, the Otter Co-op Outdoor Experience waterpark, an NHL-size arena with 500 seats (opened August 18, 2018), a fitness centre and an indoor walking track — a few blocks west of the Town Centre site.

SD35 schools physically in Aldergrove include Parkside Centennial Elementary (3300 270 St), Shortreed Community Elementary (27330 28 Ave), Betty Gilbert Middle School (26845 27 Ave) and Aldergrove Community Secondary (26850 29 Ave); a locator run for 26850 29 Ave returned Parkside Centennial, Betty Gilbert and Aldergrove Community Secondary, and catchments are address-based.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Aldergrove

items.t: Age bylaws: 55+ only: Under the Strata Property Act, ss. 123.1 and 123.2, the only legal age bylaw is 55+, in force as the only form since Nov 24, 2022; it restricts who may live in a unit, not who may own it. No Aldergrove Town Centre building is verified as 55+.

Zoning: Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 2500: governs Aldergrove; zones named in Township documents for Aldergrove parcels include Rural Zone RU-2, Community Commercial Zone C-2 and Comprehensive Development Zone CD-192, and the bylaw's Section 110.1 ladder runs from R-1B/R-1C urban lots at a 464.5 m² minimum to SR-2 at 8,094 m².

SSMUH in the Township: Zoning Bylaw No. 2500 Amendment (Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing) Bylaw No. 6020, adopted November 18, 2024, amended the Zoning Bylaw to enable small-scale multi-unit housing in most zones previously restricted to single-family or duplex dwellings; the Township estimated about 55% of its single-family and duplex lots (roughly 15,000 properties) would qualify for 3 to 4 units. That is the rule reshaping the house streets around the Town Centre — it does not change an existing condo's bylaws.

GST on new construction — the FTHB rebate: Bill C-4 received Royal Assent on March 13, 2026: 100% of the GST back on a new home up to $1 million (maximum $50,000), phasing out to $1.5 million, for eligible first-time buyers with agreements on or after March 20, 2025 and before 2031. Most Town Centre units are new or nearly new, so whether GST applied, and whether a rebate was already claimed, is a unit-by-unit question.
GST — the older New Housing Rebate: 36% of the GST, maximum $6,300, phasing out between $350,000 and $450,000, no rebate at $450,000 or more, for any new-home buyer who qualifies.

Property transfer tax (PTT): Newly Built Home Exemption: full relief on a new principal-residence home up to $1,100,000, partial to $1,150,000. Township taxes themselves were due July 2, 2026, with 5% penalties after July 2 and again after September 3, 2026, and utility fees are now billed separately.

Presales and assignments — REDMA: For any remaining Town Centre presale (including The Hart), the developer must deliver a disclosure statement and the buyer has a 7-day rescission right from the later of signing or acknowledging receipt of it; deposits are held in trust or covered by deposit protection insurance, and assignment rights are whatever the contract grants.

CMHC premium range: 0.60% of the loan at 65% loan-to-value or less, rising to 4.00% at 90.01%–95%, and 4.50% in that band with a non-traditional down payment; a one-time premium that may be added to the loan.

ALR check for the area, not the building: Much of the Township's land is in the Agricultural Land Reserve, and the Township directs owners to check a property's ALR designation and watercourses in GeoSource — irrelevant inside the Town Centre buildings themselves, but decisive for any acreage alternative a condo buyer is cross-shopping in Aldergrove.

blocks.text: Good to know about Aldergrove

items.t: The condos sit on the old mall. Aldergrove Town Centre replaces the decades-old Aldergrove Mall at 272 Street and Fraser Highway — the project's own marketing frames it as breathing new life into the historic downtown core, with over 400 homes and 45,000 sq ft of commercial space including a daycare across a six-building community.

The building names are a history lesson, on purpose. Shortreed, Jackman and Vanetta are named for Aldergrove pioneering families, The Hart for Frederick John Hart, and Creekside for its position beside Bertrand Creek — developed with naming input tied to the Aldergrove Historical Society, per the marketing firm. Useful when a listing uses a building name with no address: all of them are on Aldergrove Town Centre Drive.

Project totals moved between reports — do not quote the early ones. A 2022 construction report described three six-storey buildings plus a 10-storey building totalling 260 homes; the 2025 marketing describes six buildings and over 400 homes with The Hart as the fifth building. The scheme grew; only the disclosure statement for your building states its own count reliably.

The recreation centre arrived before the condos. The Aldergrove Credit Union Community Centre's arena opened August 18, 2018, and its canopy-covered outdoor pools are open year-round — the amenity the Town Centre markets against was already operating years before the first Town Centre building completed in 2025.

SSMUH is quietly changing the streets around the project. Township Bylaw No. 6020 (adopted November 18, 2024) enabled 3–4 units on most former single-family/duplex lots — an estimated 55% of such lots Township-wide — and in March 2026 the Township was already advancing a form-and-character development permit area for SSMUH. Expect infill plexes, not more condo buildings, as Aldergrove's next supply wave outside the core.

Read this first: Aldergrove's townhouse stock is the older 32 Avenue corridor stock west and south of the Fraser Highway / 272 Street core — not Aldergrove Town Centre.
Alderwood Manor — 27090 32 Ave. STRATA — freehold strata, strata plan NWS46, self-managed

Listings record it as a townhouse complex built in 1971 (one listing says 1973 for a later-phase unit — treat 1971 as the complex year, phase years not confirmed), Title to Land: Freehold Strata. Unit count: Not confirmed from a public source. Published rental/pet/age restrictions: Not confirmed — read the filed bylaws with the Form B.
Creekside Estates — 27125 31A Ave. STRATA — strata plan NWS2271, managed by Fort Park Property Management

Published rental/pet/age restrictions: Not confirmed. Do not confuse this complex with Creekside Villa (29A Ave, below) or with the Town Centre apartment building also named Creekside — three different properties share the name.
Creekside Villa — 27435 29A Ave. STRATA — freehold strata, plan LMS361, built 1992, 55 units, 55+
This is the one Aldergrove townhouse complex a public source states is age-restricted.

Listings record 2-level townhouses built 1982 (one listing says 1981 — year is 1981/1982, not confirmed to a single year); an MLS data sheet records Title to Land: Freehold – Strata, management by Dwell Property Management, and a bylaw-restrictions line of cats OK, dogs OK, number limit two, with restrictions — MLS-sheet-stated, the filed bylaws govern. blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Aldergrove

items.t: Form B first: The Form B Information Certificate discloses a unit's monthly strata fees, amounts owed, approved special levies still to be paid, the contingency reserve fund (CRF) balance, parking/storage and a summary of the strata's insurance; the strata must provide it within 7 days of a request, for a maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. In 1970s–1990s complexes like Aldergrove's, the Form B plus two years of minutes is where roof, envelope and plumbing history shows up.
CRF minimum: Since November 1, 2023, stratas must contribute at least 10% of the annual operating fund to the contingency reserve fund when approving budgets.

SSMUH in the Township: Zoning Bylaw No. 6020 (adopted November 18, 2024): amended Zoning Bylaw 2500 to enable 3–4 units on most lots previously restricted to single-family or duplex dwellings (about 55% of such lots, roughly 15,000 properties, per the Township).

Suites and coach houses in the Township: the secondary-suite cap is 120 m², and a coach house is a fee-simple second unit under Zoning Bylaw 2500 s.102 — never a strata lot. A house with a coach house is not townhouse stock and is not counted in. (Task brief, Township of Langley rules; bylaw

GST — FTHB rebate: Bill C-4 received Royal Assent on March 13, 2026: 100% of the GST back on a new home up to $1 million (maximum $50,000), phasing out to $1.5 million, for eligible first-time buyers with agreements on or after March 20, 2025 and before 2031. Aldergrove's townhouse stock is resale, so GST generally does not apply — the rebate matters only for a new-build cross-shop.
GST — New Housing Rebate: 36% of the GST, maximum $6,300, phasing out between $350,000 and $450,000, no rebate at $450,000 or more, for any new-home buyer who qualifies.
Down-payment programs: Home Buyers' Plan: up to $60,000 per buyer from an RRSP, repayable over 15 years. First Home Savings Account: $8,000 per year, $40,000 lifetime, combinable with the HBP.

blocks.text: Good to know about Aldergrove

items.t: Aldergrove's townhouse era predates its condo era by about 50 years. The oldest verified townhouse complex here, Alderwood Manor, is recorded as built in 1971; the first Town Centre apartment building completed in 2025. A townhouse buyer is buying into mature, self- or professionally-managed small stratas — Alderwood Manor is self-managed under NWS46 — not into a new-build warranty world.
They are counted once, here.

SSMUH is changing the streets around the complexes, not the complexes. Township Bylaw No. 6020 (adopted November 18, 2024) enabled 3–4 units on most former single-family/duplex lots — an estimated 55% of such lots Township-wide — and in March 2026 the Township was advancing a form-and-character development permit area for SSMUH. Expect infill plexes beside the 32 Avenue stratas, not new townhouse complexes, as the next supply wave.

The recreation centre is older than every new home in the core. The Aldergrove Credit Union Community Centre's arena opened August 18, 2018, and its canopy-covered outdoor pools are open year-round — the amenity beside the townhouse corridor was operating years before the Town Centre completed.

The owner-approved claims (REALTOR since 2015; 10 straight years in the FVREB Medallion Club; Top 1% of Fraser Valley Realtors; #1 in South Surrey/White Rock by MLS points for 2025 and 2026 YTD; more than $500M in sales) may be used only as page statements in that exact form.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Aldergrove
What land actually trades here

items.t: Fee-simple parcels — the default form: The established stock is freehold single-family housing on its own lots; the core plan describes residential lands in the plan area as large-lot single-family homes, with some townhouses and apartments including fourplexes on 30 Avenue west of 272 Street. Bare land, when it trades, trades in that same fee-simple form — a parcel, not a strata lot.

Lot character (Zoning Bylaw 2500, s.110.1 ladder): SR-1 minimum lot area 3,716 m² (frontage 40 m); SR-2 8,094 m² / 45 m; SR-3 1,765 m² / 27.45 m; R-1E 930 m² / 22 m; R-1D 650 m² / 18.25 m; R-1B and R-1C 464.5 m² / 15.25 m. Zones named for Aldergrove parcels include Rural Zone RU-2, Community Commercial C-2 and Comprehensive Development CD-192 — their minimum lot areas/frontages are not verified from a readable bylaw section, so no RU-2 subdivision figure is stated.

Bare-land STRATA: none verified in Aldergrove: Where bare-land strata exists elsewhere in BC it is strata tenure (Form B/fees/bylaws apply to the lot — block), but no Aldergrove lot is documented in that form here.

ALR vs non-ALR split: much of the Township's land is within the Agricultural Land Reserve; no Aldergrove-specific ALR percentage is published, so no split figure is stated. The Township directs applicants to check a property's ALR designation and watercourses in GeoSource before applying. Bertrand Creek bounds the core to the north and east.

Servicing: municipal water/sewer vs well/septic for any single Aldergrove parcel: Not confirmed — the core is urban-serviced in character and the rural south is not documented parcel-by-parcel; confirm servicing for the specific lot with the Township before pricing a build.

Market context, labelled correctly: SnapStats recorded Aldergrove detached inventory 55 / solds 9 (16%) and attached inventory 30 / solds 5 (17%) in September 2026; Langley community-level detached median was $1,345,000. SnapStats has NO land category (Detached vs "Condos & Townhomes" combined only) — no detached figure is presented as a land figure.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Aldergrove

items.t: Core plan boundary (core only): the Aldergrove Core Area is centred on Fraser Highway and 272 Street, bounded by Bertrand Creek to the north and east, 29 Avenue to the south and 270 Street to the west. Wider community boundaries are not verified.
Nearby areas: Abbotsford across 276 Street to the east, rural south Langley to the west, the US border directly south; Highway 1 runs through the Township north of Aldergrove.

Where land concentrates: two worlds — small urban lots in the core around Fraser Highway/272 Street, and large rural (RU-2) and suburban lots south and east of the core toward the border and Abbotsford.
Any other address needs its own locator run.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Aldergrove

items.t: Zoning: Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 2500: governs, with the s.110.1 minimums in. Get the parcel's zone from the Township/GeoSource first — RU-2, C-2 and CD-192 minimums are not verified from a readable section and are not filled in here.

SSMUH in the Township: Bylaw 6020 (adopted November 18, 2024) amended Bylaw 2500 to enable small-scale multi-unit housing in zones previously restricted to single-family/duplex. Bylaw 6020 has no 6-plex tier.

Suites and coach houses: secondary-suite cap is 120 m². A coach house is a fee-simple second unit under Zoning Bylaw 2500 s.102 — part of the same fee-simple title, never a separate strata lot, and it cannot be sold separately. LIVE s.102 CONFLICT — flagged, not resolved: the July 2025 bylaw text permits townhouse suites at 120 m² while the January 2025 guide says not permitted. A suite/coach-house plan for a specific lot needs the current Township position in writing. (Standing correction; framework

R-CL context (Willoughby, carried only to prevent misapplication): R-CL s.403 is 220 m² minimum / 464.5 m² maximum — a Willoughby zone figure, NOT an Aldergrove standard; do not apply it to an Aldergrove parcel.

Subdivision + servicing requirements beyond zone minimums: Not confirmed for Aldergrove parcels — never filled in from another municipality. Confirm subdivision servicing (roads, water, sewer/septic, drainage) with the Township for the specific application.

ALR rules (where ALR ground exists): check the parcel in GeoSource/ALC mapping first. Subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval, as the ALC states it. ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)). ALC residence caps: principal residence ≤500 m², suite within the principal residence only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha).
Farm class — full three-tier form: $2,500 (0.8–4 ha); $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 (under 0.8 ha); applications by October 31. A flat "$2,500+" statement is an ERROR.

Bare-land strata block (no Aldergrove bare-land strata verified — applies only if a lot is in that form): Form B diligence; depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss.123.1/123.2 + May 1, 2023 exemptions).

blocks.text: Good to know about Aldergrove

items.t: Three properties share the name "Creekside" in Aldergrove — a townhouse complex (Creekside Estates, 27125 31A Ave), Creekside Villa (27435 29A Ave), and the Town Centre apartment building named Creekside. A land or housing search by name alone will mix them; the civic address decides.

The Town Centre is a mall-site rebuild, not a land release. Its five apartment buildings (Shortreed, Jackman, Vanetta, Creekside, The Hart) share one site beside Bertrand Creek — buyers waiting for "Town Centre lots" are waiting for a product that is not offered as lots.

Aldergrove Regional Park's main entrance is at 27240 8 Avenue (Metro Vancouver) — the rural south's recreation anchor sits on the same rural road grid as the acreage parcels, which is part of that ground's appeal and its servicing reality.

The Aldergrove Credit Union Community Centre (27032 Fraser Highway) — pools, Otter Co-op Outdoor Experience, NHL-size arena (500 seats, opened August 18, 2018) — is a core amenity; rural lots south of the core are a drive from it, not a walk.

blocks.text: Mobile and manufactured homes in Aldergrove
Verified manufactured-home community: 1 — a co-operative, not a pad-rental park.
The parks and communities

items.t: Pioneer Park: MLS listings for homes in the park state "Pioneer Park is 55+", that a buyer must be accepted by the co-op and must purchase co-op shares, and that the resident pays a monthly co-op fee rather than pad rent to a landlord or strata fees to a strata corporation — the land is held through the co-operative: the buyer owns the manufactured home and holds co-op shares/occupancy rights; that is neither land ownership in fee simple, nor a strata lot, nor an MHPTA pad tenancy.
Langley Grove Estates is OTTER DISTRICT ground, not Aldergrove.
Not mobile stock in the core: Alderwood Manor (27090 32 Ave) is likewise built townhouse form. The Hart at Alder Grove Town Centre is a general-market condo project with no age restriction stated.
Manufactured homes on own fee-simple lots: No named own-lot manufactured-home community was verified for Aldergrove.

RV parks/campgrounds: no RV park or campground in Aldergrove was established by any source as year-round manufactured-home tenure, so none is documented as a manufactured-home park here. Not confirmed as mobile stock.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Aldergrove

items.t: Core frame: the Aldergrove Core Area is centred on Fraser Highway and 272 Street, bounded by Bertrand Creek to the north and east, 29 Avenue to the south and 270 Street to the west; wider community boundaries are not verified. Pioneer Park sits outside the core, at the south edge on 0 Avenue — the border road.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect park-home buyers in Aldergrove

items.t: Co-op occupancy rules are the co-op's own: listings state buyer acceptance by the co-op and a share purchase as conditions of buying into Pioneer Park; the provincial strata exemptions (spouse/partner, caregiver, legacy, defined children — SPA Regulation 7.01, expanded May 1, 2023) govern STRATA 55+ bylaws and do not automatically apply inside a co-operative.

Strata block (applies to Creekside Villa-type strata purchases in this community, and to any bare-land strata park a buyer cross-shops): Form B diligence (strata fee, amounts owed, approved levies, CRF balance, parking/storage, insurance summary; Form B within 7 days of request, max $35 plus up to 25¢ per page); depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum CRF 10% since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid since November 24, 2022 (SPA ss.123.1/123.2 + Regulation 7.01; spouse/caregiver/legacy exemptions including the May 1, 2023 expansion; a 45+ bylaw is VOID and does NOT convert to 55+). An older Creekside Villa listing's "45+ rancher" line is exactly that void form — MLS data for the same complex records "Restricted Age: 55+."

Township frame: Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw 2500 governs; Section 110.1 ladder in Township council reports — R-1B/R-1C 464.5 m², R-1D 650 m², R-1E 930 m², SR-3 1,765 m², SR-1 3,716 m², SR-2 8,094 m² minimum lot areas. SSMUH Bylaw 6020 (adopted Nov 18, 2024; NO 6-plex tier); suite cap 120 m²; a coach house is a fee-simple second unit under s.102, never strata. SSMUH does not apply to pad tenancies, and it creates no added-unit right inside a co-op park — Pioneer Park's form is governed by its co-op documents and its zoning, not SSMUH. The Aldergrove Community Plan and Aldergrove Core Area Plan govern the community within the Township OCP.

ALR: much of the Township's land is within the Agricultural Land Reserve; the Township directs applicants to check a property's ALR designation and watercourses in GeoSource before applying. Where a parcel IS in the ALR: subdivision requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)); caps — principal 500 m² or less, suite within the principal only, additional residence 90 m² (40 ha or less) / 186 m² (over 40 ha). Farm class runs on the full three-tier test ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by October 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an error wherever met.

blocks.text: Good to know about Aldergrove

items.t: Aldergrove's one manufactured-home community runs on a third legal system: It is not strata (no Form B, no SPA bylaws) and not a pad tenancy (no MHPTA cap, no RTB pad rules): Pioneer Park is a co-operative, and its acceptance, share and occupancy documents are the whole rulebook. Buyers who diligence it as either of the other two forms will ask the wrong questions.

Pioneer Park sits on 0 Avenue: 27111 0 Ave is the community's south edge on the US border, a rural setting apart from the Fraser Highway core — the opposite corner of Aldergrove from Creekside Villa and Jackman Manor.

The "Creekside" name is used twice in the core: Creekside Villa (27435 29A Ave, 55+, LMS361) and Creekside Estates (27125 31A Ave, no age restriction found) are different complexes — and neither is a manufactured-home park.

faq.a: The Township core plan describes the pre-Town Centre core as large-lot single-family homes with some townhouses and fourplexes on 30 Avenue west of 272 Street — so the realistic comparison set is Town Centre buildings against each other, and against townhouses, not against an older condo stock.
faq.q: Is there an older, cheaper condo building in Aldergrove to compare against the Town Centre?

faq.a: Shortreed (27215), Jackman (27218, 71 homes, 6 storeys, wood-frame) and Vanetta (27254) are the Phase 1 buildings; Creekside (27249, 66 homes, 4 storeys, wood-frame, beside Bertrand Creek) is Phase 2; The Hart is the fifth building, released in 2025, with its civic address not confirmed.
faq.q: Which Town Centre building is which?

faq.a: Jackman and Creekside are recorded as wood-frame; Vanetta is described in listings as steel-frame with concrete floors, the project's only steel-frame building — a listing claim to confirm in the building's own documents before paying a premium for it.
faq.q: Are the buildings wood-frame or concrete/steel?

faq.a: The Form B states the unit's fee and the CRF balance, but in a first-year strata those figures come from the developer's interim budget, not from actual operating history — the first annual general meeting budget is where buyers learn the real number. Ask for the interim budget, the warranty (2-5-10) terms, and when the first depreciation report is due.
faq.q: What do strata fees cover in a brand-new building, and can they jump?

faq.a: Long-term rental-restriction bylaws are void province-wide since Nov 24, 2022, so a Town Centre strata cannot ban long-term renting; short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw, and the registered bylaws for your building are the check.

The Township core plan describes the pre-Town Centre core as large-lot single-family homes with some townhouses and fourplexes on 30 Avenue west of 272 Street — the realistic comparison set is Town Centre buildings against each other, and against townhouses such as Willow Creek Estates and Creekside Villa.
faq.q: Is there an older, cheaper condo building in Aldergrove to compare against the Town Centre?

faq.a: Shortreed (27215), Jackman (27218, 71 homes, 6 storeys, wood-frame) and Vanetta (27254) are the Phase 1 buildings; Creekside (27249, 66 homes, 4 storeys, wood-frame, beside Bertrand Creek) is Phase 2; The Hart is the fifth building, released in 2025, with its civic address not confirmed.
faq.q: Which Town Centre building is which?

faq.a: One verified community: Pioneer Park (27111 0 Ave), a 55+ manufactured-home co-operative. No pad-rental park was verified in Aldergrove, and Langley Grove Estates is Otter District ground, not this community.
faq.q: What manufactured homes can I actually buy in Aldergrove?

faq.a: Tenure. A pad park rents you a site under the MHPTA; Pioneer Park is a co-operative — listings state you must be accepted by the co-op, purchase co-op shares ($9,200 in one listing, refunded upon sale), and pay a monthly co-op fee ($510 in the same listing) instead of pad rent.
faq.q: How is Pioneer Park different from a normal manufactured-home park?

faq.a: unresolved on the listings: one states "Strictly 55plus (both occupants must be 55)," another states only that the park is 55+ with occupancy limited to 2 occupants who are 55+. A co-op sets its own rules and the strata exemptions do not automatically apply — get the co-op's current rule in writing before offering.
faq.q: Do both of us have to be 55 at Pioneer Park?

faq.a: No — the MHPTA caps (2.3% for 2026, 2.2% for 2027, plus the proportional amount) govern pad tenancies, and a co-op fee is not pad rent.
faq.q: Does the pad-rent cap protect me at Pioneer Park?

faq.a: What is verified is the form class — individual two-unit buildings on single lots under the zoning of their day, plus the core plan's record of fourplexes on 30 Avenue west of 272 Street as a plan description of form.
faq.q: Is there a duplex development in Aldergrove I can buy into?

faq.a: No. A fourplex is a four-unit building; the plan sentence records the housing forms present in the plan area.
faq.q: The core plan mentions fourplexes — are those duplexes?

faq.a: Match the lot to the zone minimums first: R-1B/R-1C need 464.5 m², R-1D 650 m², R-1E 930 m², SR-3 1,765 m², SR-1 3,716 m² and SR-2 8,094 m² under Bylaw 2500 Section 110.1 in Township council reports; RU-2, C-2 and CD-192 minimums could not be confirmed from a readable bylaw section, and parcel ALR status must be checked in GeoSource.
faq.q: What lot size do I need to subdivide?

faq.a: Aldergrove is in the Township of Langley, whose eastern boundary is 276 Street at Abbotsford and whose southern boundary is the United States border.

SD35 catchment is address-based; for the sample address 26850 29 Avenue the SD35 School Locator returns Parkside Centennial Elementary, Betty Gilbert Middle and Aldergrove Community Secondary. Other addresses may fall in different catchments, so check the exact address in the locator.
faq.q: Which schools serve an Aldergrove address?

faq.a: TransLink route 503 runs from 272 Street at Fraser Highway via Langley Centre to Surrey Central Station, and BC Transit route 21 connects Aldergrove with Abbotsford from the same 272 Street stop.
faq.q: What bus service runs from Aldergrove?
